claims.title: Collaborative inputs can make CIOH merge distinct owners
claims.mechanism: compare naive co-spend clustering with known collaborative ownership
limitations: No chain-wide ground truth

claims.title: Unnecessary inputs can expose PayJoin participation
claims.mechanism: apply single-input coverage and transaction-shape diagnostics as incomplete approximations to unnecessary-input analysis
limitations: The implementation does not enumerate arbitrary dispensable input subsets
The single-input coverage diagnostic does not implement the full fee-aware UIH1 and UIH2 definitions
Protocol form and ownership ground truth must be supplied

claims.title: Construction fingerprints can support clustering
limitations: Address reuse is a weak label
Local sample is not chain-wide

claims.title: Seeded mappings can propagate across overlapping pseudonym graphs
limitations: Bitcoin seeds are derived from retained correspondence
Published social datasets are not reproduced

claims.title: Recurring counterparty structure can link pseudonyms beyond co-spend
claims.mechanism: compare rarity-aware or common-neighbour structure under an independent entity label
limitations: The current paired fixtures evaluate common neighbours, not seeded N-S propagation
Vanity-prefix labels and entity-centred subgraphs are selected
The contrast is not representative of services or the chain

claims.title: A cross-view mapping can support prediction of missing links
claims.mechanism: mapping-assisted link prediction over incomplete views
limitations: Dummy-node zero semantics unresolved
Pruning, revisitation and learned feature model are incomplete

claims.title: Values can leave few plausible subtransaction mappings
claims.mechanism: enumerate mappings and measure their link distribution
limitations: Maurer requires exact conservation
Some Boltzmann modes remain incomplete
Entropy alone is not a privacy certificate

claims.title: Preparing fixed-denomination inputs can create a unilateral transaction fingerprint
claims.mechanism: compare denomination-preparation transaction shapes with an explicitly defined control population
limitations: The CTP statement is a qualification without an independent cited experiment
A control population and fingerprint definition are required

claims.title: Amount constraints can force links shared by every feasible CoinJoin partition
claims.mechanism: enumerate a declared mapping family and return only links present in every feasible mapping
limitations: Certainty is conditional on the declared mapping and fee model
CoinJoin Sudoku examples are not yet exposed as a separately identified reproduction

claims.title: Partial clusters induce an attributed directed multigraph rather than a complete user network
claims.mechanism: contract only declared cluster edges while preserving transfer direction, multiplicity and attributes
limitations: The current registry does not identify a single canonical contraction implementation
A representation fixture must prove that parallel transfers are not silently collapsed

claims.title: Candidate-origin ambiguity can decay under value-flow and auxiliary knowledge
claims.mechanism: propagate model-relative origins and distinguish candidate elimination from graph fracture
limitations: Full published datasets are not reproduced
The synthetic graph-fracture fixture does not establish an exponential deanonymization rate
Value-flow traceability and ownership attribution remain distinct

claims.title: Repeated observations can disclose persistent sender behavior
claims.mechanism: accumulate observations across rounds and estimate a persistent sender profile
limitations: A longitudinal disclosure fixture and explicit observation model are required

claims.title: Repeated batches can constrain sender-recipient assignments through perfect matching
claims.mechanism: intersect feasible sender-recipient matchings across observations
limitations: A separate perfect-matching disclosure fixture is required
This mechanism must not be represented as value-flow ancestry

claims.title: Linked post-CoinJoin coins can narrow pre-CoinJoin origin clusters
claims.mechanism: intersect cluster-lifted candidate-origin sets across observations
limitations: JoinMarket detection and recursive clustering are not reproduced
Historical purchase experiment is not reproduced

claims.title: Robust privacy requires multiple plausible counterfactual paths
claims.mechanism: enumerate amount-plausible edge-disjoint paths with temporal qualifications
limitations: The production k-routes implementation belongs to the defensive project
Current weighted path count is not a k-routes oracle

claims.title: Point-in-time entropy is not a sufficient privacy certificate
claims.mechanism: contrast equal entropy with different future intersection or auxiliary-information outcomes
limitations: The paired counterexample is synthetic
The fixture falsifies sufficiency but does not measure real-world attack frequency

claims.title: Sparse feature vectors can support record-linkage deanonymization
claims.mechanism: measure nearest-neighbour similarity before applying auxiliary-information record linkage
limitations: The frozen signature snapshot contains 200 selected records
The signature-generation recipe and original comparison population were not preserved
Auxiliary origins are sampled from each target signature rather than independently observed
Record identity is not wallet ownership ground truth
The published Netflix corpus is not reproduced
